description: This file defines the interface for handling chunked file formats, including initialization, reading, writing, and searching chunks within the file. It declares structures, constants, and function prototypes for managing chunked data, likely used in a larger project dealing with binary file formats or content serialization.

methods.name: init_chunkfile
methods.description: Initializes a 'struct chunkfile' for either reading or writing a file with the chunk format, depending on provided parameters.

methods.name: free_chunkfile
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a 'struct chunkfile'.

methods.name: get_num_chunks
methods.description: Returns the number of chunks in the given chunkfile.

methods.name: add_chunk
methods.description: Adds a new chunk to the chunkfile with specified ID, size, and write function.

methods.name: write_chunkfile
methods.description: Writes the chunkfile data to disk or output from memory.

methods.name: read_table_of_contents
methods.description: Reads the table of contents from a memory-mapped file representing a chunked file.

methods.name: pair_chunk
methods.description: Locates a chunk by ID within the chunkfile and provides a pointer to its start and size.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads a specified chunk by ID and processes it using a provided callback function.

methods.name: oid_version
methods.description: Returns the version number of the object ID algorithm used, based on the provided 'struct git_hash_algo'.

ctags.name: chunk_read_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const unsigned char * chunk_start,size_t chunk_size,void * data)
